learning_outcomes.text: Explain accessibility principles and who they serve
Build semantic HTML as the foundation of accessibility
Implement keyboard operability and focus management
Use ARIA correctly and only when needed
Meet colour, contrast and visual accessibility needs
Test accessibility with tools and assistive technology

integrative_case: Audit and fix an inaccessible form-and-modal flow: replace div soup with semantic HTML, make everything keyboard operable with correct focus management, add ARIA only where semantics fall short, fix contrast and visible focus, then verify with a screen reader and an automated checker, documenting what you found and fixed.
